video:video.video:title: Stowmap in 20 seconds
video:video.video:description: A scan of a Mac startup disk in Stowmap: the map appears, two clicks go into the home folder, three hidden folders are collected and moved to the Trash, then Copy & Verify copies six folders to two drives and verifies every file.

video:video.video:title: Copy & Verify in Stowmap
video:video.video:description: Six folders are copied to two drives in Stowmap. A ring fills while the copy speed is graphed, the files are verified, and the result reads All 1,204 files verified.
